#### **Overview**

This project involved designing and publishing a professional portfolio website using Quarto and GitHub Pages. The website showcases my coursework, marketing analytics projects, technical skills, and professional development in a clean and organized format. Throughout the project, I learned how to build a multi-page website, manage content with Quarto, and publish it online using GitHub.

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

#### **Learning Outcomes**

- Design and develop a professional portfolio website.
- Organize projects into a clear and easy-to-navigate format.
- Publish a website using GitHub Pages.
- Apply Quarto to create dynamic web pages.
- Present technical and analytical work in a professional portfolio.

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
